comment: ACTIVE visual ensemble config (Family-Safe, precision-tuned). NudeNet is the always-present first model. Drop a second NSFW ONNX file next to it and name it exactly yolo_nsfw.onnx (or edit 'file' below) to enable cross-model confirmation. With 2 models loaded, a frame is only SKIPPED when the models agree (consensus) OR one vote is very strong (>= hard_confidence), so a lone weak 'sexy/swimwear/romance' vote is never turned into a skip. Missing models are logged and skipped, so this file is safe to ship before the second model is present.
